ctgov.note: Sponsor 'Evofem Biosciences' returned 0 P1/P2/P3 trials. The investigator-led NIH-funded Phase 4 SOLOSEC trichomoniasis trial is post-marketing and not Evofem-sponsored.

products.name: PHEXXI (lactic acid / citric acid / potassium bitartrate)

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Evofem is a commercial-stage women's health company. PHEXXI and SOLOSEC are marketed. Pipeline candidates EVO100 (chlamydia/gonorrhea prevention) and EVO200 (recurrent BV prevention) hold FDA QIDP designations but have no Evofem-sponsored active P1/P2/P3 trials registered on clinicaltrials.gov as of the snapshot date. The MPT (Phexxi + OB-002) HIV-prevention candidate is preclinical and partner-dependent (Orion Biotechnology).
excluded_preclinical: EVO200 - recurrent BV prevention (formulation work; no active clinical trial)
MPT candidate (Phexxi + OB-002 CCR5 antagonist) for HIV prevention - preclinical, partner Orion Biotechnology
excluded_legacy_terminated: EVO100 for chlamydia/gonorrhea prevention - prior Phase 3 AMPOWER program completed; no active Evofem-sponsored P3 follow-up registered
excluded_partner_owned: NIH-funded investigator-led Phase 4 SOLOSEC vs metronidazole for trichomoniasis (post-marketing, not Evofem-sponsored)
